verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review agent, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence only documents cubic's own MCP server, which coding agents connect to as clients. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here, and nothing shows cubic can plug in third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
